provenance.dimension_basis: manufacturer family envelope; exact video variant uncertain
provenance.hidden_structure: hinge and latch internal dimensions inferred; no OEM service geometry asserted

review.frame_coverage: 1836 source frames at 24000/1001 fps; both compressed videos decoded to 1836 frames
review.visual_review: All 14 encoded first/middle/last shot review boards inspected, plus 17 geometry/camera diagnostics and revised idle cavity lamp frames
review.revision: Replaced incorrect final-shot camera branch using a full cabinet calibration from shared source footage. Revised window proportions, lamp guard, cabinet cover, cavity lip, filter opening and hinge barrels; source idle lamp off.
review.mechanics: Independent physical left hinged door with prior source free-edge measurements. Open, closed and display changes replayed at source frame rate.
review.geometry: Native v036 manifold/positive volume/recess/feet checks passed; structural door versus cabinet has no surface intersections at 13 sampled angles from 0 to 120 degrees. Hinge and latch coupling contacts excluded; no continuous clearance proof.
review.alignment_limit: Camera, material response, tiny labels and cavity reflections remain approximate. Reconstructed cabinet and fixed scene do not reproduce hands, food, the filming environment or its reflections. Observed pixel residuals do not establish all-frame pixel-perfect accuracy.
review.display: Green source emission masks on the physical reconstructed LED plane; blurred and occluded values preserve extraction limitations
review.scene: Frozen Tangyuan kitchen with unchanged external lighting. Internal cavity lamp is inferred from visible operating state.
review.hidden_structure: Unseen sheet construction, exact hinge hardware and dimensions are inferred from source family dimensions and images.
